items.text: Final report: Rams ruled out LB Nate Landman (concussion); WR Puka Nacua (calf, sat out Friday) and CB Trent McDuffie (groin) are questionable. WR Davante Adams (hamstring surgery), K Blake Grupe, DL Kobie Turner and TE Terrance Ferguson are on IR.

Final report: Raiders ruled out WR Dont'e Thornton Jr. (hamstring) and TE Carter Runyon (foot); RB Mike Washington Jr. is questionable. Brock Bowers and Kolton Miller have no designation; Kirk Cousins starts.
